title: 第七章 阵法第八章 驿站刺杀
content_zh:
黎明破晓，天空放亮。
在许世安坟前呆了一夜的段白语，收拾情绪，面色平静，好似什么都没有发生过一般，带着白宣走出玉真观，来到一匹马匹之前，轻笑道：“世安，我凉州多骏马，你日后为镇北王，当熟知马性，我教你的，你还没忘吧。”
“没忘。”
看着冷静下来的段白语，白宣心中不禁一凛，他不知这一夜段白语想了什么，但他知道这一夜的时间，段白语完全进入了角色。
一时之间，白宣不知道是要感叹武威段氏的世家女可怕，还是一个丧失了孩子的母亲可怕，又或者说都很可怕，而现在的段白语两者皆是。
念头一闪而过，白宣干净利落地翻身上马。
他在玉真观也学过马。
许世安这个正经的王府公子学的东西，他都学过。
毕竟一开始，段白语对许世安的规划并非按王爷标准培养，也没有什么不能教给白宣的。
“来时为了节省时间，不曾用马车，故而需劳烦王妃骑马，待到了前面州郡再换马车。”李道衍道。
通常来说，女眷出行乘坐马车。
尤其是段白语刚刚丧子，坐马车最合适。
“不必了，李先生，我段氏女没这么柔弱，当年我也是上过战场的。”段白语说完之后，翻身上马，动作比之白宣还要干净利落几分。
李道衍见状也不再劝，和许玉华先后上马，策马扬鞭，朝着凉州治所宣武郡而去。
五百轻骑紧随其后，风驰电掣，化作一道白线。
白宣骑乘白马，破风而行，面上却不禁露出一丝疑惑的神色。
这不是他第一次骑马，但这骑马的速度远远超过了他平日里骑马的速度，至少快了一倍，而且还在增加当中。
心念感应，天地之间的元气在不断地注入到在场每一个人乃至每一匹马上。
士兵之间，一呼一吸之间，自有韵律。
五百骑兵，此刻却好似一头凶悍的猛兽。

破风而行，气流自动绕开。
阵法！
两个大字如晴天霹雳般浮现在白宣的脑海之中。
兵阵中有阵法师。
白宣心中感应，将所有的气息归纳在一块儿，最终找到了核心——李道衍。
“仲父，您是一位阵法师？”
白宣看着李道衍，语气中不自觉地带上几分亲切。
这个世界，有一指开江，御剑飞行的绝世武者，也有形如小山，飞天遁地的大妖。
但要说最尊贵的身份是什么的话，那毋庸置疑便是阵法师。
借天地之威，用生灵之力。
他来到此方世界修行，最初对这个世界一无所知，全靠自身感悟，不曾与人交流。
好不容易化形了之后，方才知晓了不少的事。
当今之世，人族最强，大周占据最富饶的中原。
而妖族则被驱赶到十万大山、极地冰原、东方汪洋这些穷山恶水，人迹罕至的地方。
彼时，白宣来到这个世界几十年，还没有和人交流过，迫切地想要了解世界的真相，以及享受享受花花世界。
结果因为长相过于俊美，被一个妖王之子看上，想让他做娈童。
白宣拼了命，这才逃了出来，保住了自己的清白。
之后卧薪尝胆，潜心修炼，渡过天劫，他第一件事就是去找回场子。
冲入妖城之中，以一己之力，凿穿三万妖军，杀了妖王全家，一个不留。
他当时第一次发现自己这么厉害，险些要萌生“我不吃牛肉”的心思。

只是在他膨胀之前，妖国反应过来，又有三万妖军袭来，同样是三万，但这一次的力量完全不同。
content_en:
Dawn breaks and the sky lights up.
Duan Baiyu, who stayed in front of Xu Shi'an's grave all night, collected his emotions and looked calm, as if nothing had happened. He led Bai Xuan out of Yuzhen Temple and came to a horse. He chuckled and said: "Shi'an, I have many horses in Liangzhou. You will be the king of Zhenbei in the future. You should know the nature of horses. You haven't forgotten what I taught you."
"I haven't forgotten."
Looking at Duan Baiyu who had calmed down, Bai Xuan couldn't help but tremble in his heart. He didn't know what Duan Baiyu was thinking about this night, but he knew that during this night, Duan Baiyu completely entered the role.
For a moment, Bai Xuan didn't know whether to lament that the daughter of the Wuwei Duan family was terrible, or that a mother who lost her child was terrible, or that they were both terrible, and now Duan Baiyu was both.
The thought flashed past, and Bai Xuan got on his horse neatly.
He also learned horse racing in Yuzhenguan.
He has learned everything that Xu Shian, a serious prince of the royal family, has learned.
After all, Duan Baiyu's plan for Xu Shian was not to train him according to the prince's standards at the beginning, and there was nothing he could not teach Bai Xuan.
"In order to save time when I came here, I didn't use a carriage, so I had to bother the princess to ride a horse, and then change the carriage when I got to the prefecture ahead." Li Daoyan said.
Generally speaking, women travel by horse-drawn carriage.
Especially since Duan Baiyu had just lost his son, riding in a carriage would be the most appropriate thing.
"No need, Mr. Li, my Duan daughter is not that weak. I was also on the battlefield back then." After Duan Baiyu finished speaking, he got on his horse and his movements were a bit cleaner than Bai Xuan's.
When Li Daoyan saw this, he stopped trying to persuade him. He and Xu Yuhua mounted their horses one after another, whipped their horses, and headed towards Xuanwu County, the seat of Liangzhou.
Five hundred Qingqi followed closely behind, turning into a white line with lightning speed.
Bai Xuan rode a white horse and walked through the wind, but he couldn't help but have a look of doubt on his face.
This is not the first time he rides a horse, but the speed he rides is far higher than the speed he usually rides, at least twice as fast, and it is still increasing.
In response to his thoughts, the vitality between heaven and earth is constantly being injected into everyone present and even every horse.
There is a rhythm between the soldiers, every breath and every breath.
The five hundred cavalrymen looked like a ferocious beast at this moment.
Walking against the wind, the air flow will automatically bypass it.
Formation!
Two big characters appeared in Bai Xuan's mind like a bolt from the blue.
There is an array master in the military formation.
Bai Xuan sensed it in his heart, put all the auras together, and finally found the core - Li Daoyan.
"Father Zhong, are you an array master?"
Bai Xuan looked at Li Daoyan, his tone unconsciously filled with kindness.
In this world, there are peerless warriors who can open rivers with their fingers and fly with swords, and there are also great demons who are shaped like hills and can fly into the sky and escape from the earth.
But if we want to talk about the most noble identity, it is undoubtedly the formation master.
Borrow the power of heaven and earth and use the power of living beings.
He came to this world to practice. At first he knew nothing about this world and relied solely on his own insights without communicating with others.
After finally transforming, I learned a lot of things.
In today's world, the human race is the strongest, and the Great Zhou occupies the richest Central Plains.
The demon clan was driven to inaccessible places such as the Hundred Thousand Mountains, the polar ice fields, and the vast oceans of the East.
At that time, Bai Xuan had been in this world for decades and had not interacted with anyone. He was eager to understand the truth of the world and enjoy the colorful world.
As a result, because he was too handsome, he was attracted by the son of a demon king and wanted to make him a prostitute.
Bai Xuan tried his best to escape and preserve his innocence.
After that, he worked hard, devoted himself to cultivation, and survived the catastrophe. The first thing he did was to find his place.
He rushed into the demon city, pierced through the 30,000 demon army with his own strength, and killed the demon king's entire family, leaving no one behind.
It was the first time that he realized that he was so powerful, and he almost had the thought of "I don't eat beef."
But before he expanded, the demon country reactedCome, another 30,000 demon army attacks, also 30,000, but this time the power is completely different.
